message: 己が技を

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai, why are you transformed?! Don't tell me a demon attacked!!」
Just as I entered the old school building on my way to the Student Council room, I unexpectedly ran into Ria-senpai.

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, that's not it? It's just...」

name: Ria
message: 「...Synn-kun, could you come with me? It's something related to the Crusaders, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, I don't mind, but... Senpai, aren't you feeling a bit down?」

name: Ria
message: 「Uh, w-well. Ahahaha...」
Unable to leave a despondent Ria-senpai alone, I followed behind her.
Along the way, Ria-senpai only let out breaths akin to sighs, never saying a single word to me.
And where we arrived was--

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't this your house, Senpai?」

name: Helena
message: 「What is it, Ria? Isn't it still too early for you to be coming home?」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis...」

name: Helena
message: 「Good grief, what a spiritless reply.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, go ahead and tell me. Synn-chan, you listen closely too.」

name: Ria
message: 「...Big Sis, is it possible to hand over my Rosary to someone else right now?」

name: Helena
message: 「It is possible. Why do you ask?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-Thank goodness...」

name: Helena
message: 「Answer my question.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm graduating next year. I think that's why, but it seems I've passed the suitable age for the Rosary.」

name: Ria
message: 「Lately, my angelic powers have stopped growing too, and I tend to hold everyone back...」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, for me to remain a member of the Crusaders, I need a stronger weapon!」

name: Ria
message: 「If I can't get my hands on that...」

name: Helena
message: 「You intend to find a talented child and abdicate the Rosary... the power of Lumiel, the Angel of Flash, to them?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, are you planning to retire!?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'll stay on the Student Council until the end of my term!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So that's what this is about, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy! If you noticed, stop Ria-senpai!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lookin' at Ria-chan all down in the dumps is rough, yeah, but if she's decided to pack up her own wilted ambition, what am I s'posed to say?」

name: Helena
message: 「U-fu-fu\s04 You want nothing to do with demons or Re-Crea, yet you still want the fun Student Council life. Oh, how selfish--such a naughty girl doing as she pleases♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Really, Ria, jumping to your own conclusions and saying such arrogant things. Only your boobs grew bigger--your big sister is so sad!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's not like that at all!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san, you say some pretty harsh things without batting an eye, don't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I want to fight alongside you and the others too, Synn-kun! But at this rate I'll just hold you back... so...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ria, that's pure conceit.」

name: Helena
message: 「You talk as if you've already mastered the techniques of a Guardian Angel.」

name: Helena
message: 「Lend me your Holy Spear for a moment.」

name: Ria
message: 「...? Here you go.」

name: Helena
message: 「How nostalgic...」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaa!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwah!」

name: Helena
message: 「Here, you can have it back.」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Big Sis, what was that just now!? I don't know anything like that!」

name: Helena
message: 「Just a practice swing?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, it's not a technique or anything, you know? The tip of my blade just happened to break the speed of sound」

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just happened to...」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuu~. Retirement canceled! I'm going to go practice! Synn-kun, help me out!」

name: Helena
message: 「Fohohoho, that's my little sister. I'm counting on you」
I transformed as well so I could train alongside Ria-senpai.
Afterward, even as I felt the pleasant fatigue of training, I still couldn't manage a practice swing like Helena-san's. It looks like I have a long way to go.
